purpose: Describe an action or property by resemblance.
keywords: Noun / plain phrase + みたいに + predicate.
I want to fly through the sky like a bird.
It is hot like summer today.
formation: Noun / plain phrase + みたいに + predicate.
restrictions: に makes the resemblance modify the following action or description.
mistake: Use みたいな when directly modifying a noun.
